name: 103Graphics Media Inspector
author: Mamdouh Kaldas

sections.description:
103Graphics Media Inspector displays clear, sortable information about your WordPress media files directly in your Dashboard. Instantly filter your library by file type, minimum size, or count, and export results to CSV or print a professional report.

No complicated setup required. After activation, simply visit Media > 103Graphics Media Inspector for instant results.

Features:
– Sort and filter by file type, size, or number of results
– Preview thumbnails for images and icons for PDFs/videos
– Show or hide size variants (WordPress-generated thumbnails)
– One-click CSV export matches your current filter view
– Beautiful print-friendly report with your site’s logo and name

License

GPLv2 or later

Credits

By Mamdouh Kaldas
Contributor: elmalak
Support and feedback: WordPress.org plugin forum
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/103graphics-media-inspector/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Media > 103Graphics Media Inspector in your Dashboard
  4. Use the filters, export, or print your media report
sections.faq:
What version of PHP is required?

PHP 7.4 or newer, and WordPress 5.7+.

Can I search by filename, author, or date?

This version focuses on high speed and simplicity: filter by Type, Min KB, Count, or Show Variants.

Does export/print exactly match current view?

Yes, what you filter is what you get – your export or print matches the filtered table.

Where do screenshots and banners go?

Please do not include screenshots or banners in your plugin ZIP. Add them in the SVN /assets/ folder after approval.
